name: ads-and-tracking
title: Ads & Tracking
description: Ads and trackers with few false positives. Start here.

name: ads-and-tracking-extended
title: Ads & Tracking (Extended)
description: Aggressive ad, tracker, telemetry and pop-up blocking. Blocks more, may need occasional allowlisting.

name: ads-regional
title: Regional Ads
description: Ad servers for non-English websites and apps: Arabic, Chinese, Russian/Ukrainian/Bulgarian, Turkish, Persian, Hebrew, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Indonesian, European languages and more. Add next to ads-and-tracking or the extended list.

name: mobile-ads
title: Mobile Ads
description: Ad networks used inside Android and iOS apps.

name: mobile-spyware
title: Mobile Spyware & Telemetry
description: Phone-maker and app telemetry/tracking (Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo/Realme, Vivo, TikTok) plus Android trackers.

name: youtube-ads
title: YouTube Ads
description: Google/YouTube ad servers. Partial: DNS cannot block all YouTube video ads (see note below).

name: gambling
title: Gambling
description: Online casinos, sports betting, poker, lotteries and other gambling sites.

name: adult
title: Adult Content
description: Porn and other adult (NSFW) sites (see Safe Search tip below).

name: social-media
title: Social Media
description: Social networks: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Snapchat, Reddit, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Tumblr, Threads, Bluesky, Discord and more. WhatsApp is not blocked.

name: smart-tv
title: Smart TV & Streaming Devices
description: Tracking and ads on smart TVs, streaming sticks and game consoles (Samsung, LG webOS, Roku, Amazon Fire, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo).

name: game-consoles
title: Game Consoles
description: Ads in the system menus and telemetry of PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch consoles. Small and safe for online play (on Xbox it also hides Game Pass Perks).

name: security
title: Security (Malware, Phishing, Scams)
description: Malware, phishing, scams and fake shops from threat-intelligence feeds. Recommended for everyone.

name: stalkerware
title: Stalkerware & Phone Monitoring
description: Spy and monitoring apps that can be secretly installed on a phone to track messages and location. Also blocks parental-control apps such as Bark, so don't use it if you rely on one.

name: crypto-mining
title: Crypto Mining (Cryptojacking)
description: Hidden crypto-mining scripts and mining pools (cryptojacking). Exchanges like Coinbase/Binance are not blocked.

name: phishing-and-scams
title: Phishing & Scams
description: Phishing sites (fake bank, PayPal, Microsoft and delivery logins), scams and fake shops. Already included in security; use this if you only want phishing/scam protection.

name: live-streaming
title: Live-Streaming & Video-Chat Apps
description: Bigo Live, Likee, MICO, SUGO, Poppo, Chamet, Tango, StreamKar, LiveMe, 17LIVE, Uplive, Hago, Yalla, SoulChill, Azar, HOLLA, Mango, GOGO LIVE, SuperLive, Kumu, Ahlan, Ola Party, Hiya, Nimo TV and ~30 more paid live/video-chat apps (see note below).

name: dating
title: Dating
description: Dating sites and apps: Tinder, Bumble, Badoo, Hinge, OkCupid, Plenty of Fish, Match, Grindr, Tantan, happn, Hily, Boo, Taimi, Muzz, Coffee Meets Bagel and ~10,000 dating websites.

name: vpn-proxy-bypass
title: VPN, Proxy & DNS Bypass
description: VPNs, web proxies and encrypted-DNS services that people use to get around blocking. Use with the other lists to stop bypassing (may block a work VPN).

name: piracy
title: Piracy
description: Illegal movie, TV, music and software download and streaming sites (torrents, warez).

name: drugs
title: Drugs
description: Sites selling or promoting illegal drugs.

name: online-games
title: Online Games
description: Online and browser gaming sites, including Steam, Roblox and Epic Games.

name: violence-hate
title: Violence & Hate
description: Violent, aggressive and hate-speech sites.

name: ai-chatbots
title: AI Chatbots
description: AI chatbots and writing tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, DeepSeek, Character.AI...). Useful for schools and homework time.

name: safesearch-bypass
title: SafeSearch Bypass
description: Search engines that can't enforce SafeSearch. Use with adult so explicit results can't be reached through other search engines.

name: gaming-platforms
title: Gaming Platforms
description: Roblox, Fortnite/Epic, Free Fire, PUBG/BGMI, Minecraft, Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, EA, Riot (League, Valorant), Battle.net, Ubisoft, Call of Duty, Clash of Clans, Mobile Legends, Genshin Impact, Candy Crush, Among Us.

name: youtube
title: YouTube
description: All of YouTube, including YouTube Kids and embedded YouTube videos on other sites. For homework or bedtime.

name: video-streaming
title: Video Streaming
description: Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, Hulu, Max, Paramount+, Peacock, Shahid, OSN+, STARZPLAY, Viu, iQIYI, WeTV, Crunchyroll, Tubi, Pluto TV, JioHotstar, ZEE5, Sony LIV, Twitch, Kick, Apple TV+.

name: messaging
title: Messaging Apps
description: Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Messenger, Signal, Viber, LINE, Kik, imo, WeChat, Threema, Botim. Blocks calls and chats in these apps.

name: chat-strangers
title: Chat with Strangers
description: Omegle-style random video and text chat sites (OmeTV, Chatroulette, Emerald Chat, Monkey, Uhmegle and more).

name: cheating
title: Homework Cheating
description: Homework-answer and essay-writing sites (Chegg, Course Hero, Brainly, Gauth, Studocu, essay mills).

name: remote-control
title: Remote Control Tools
description: AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk, UltraViewer, ScreenConnect and other remote-access tools that 'tech support' scammers use. Also blocks legitimate remote IT support.

name: crypto-trading
title: Crypto Trading
description: Crypto exchanges, trading platforms and wallets (Binance, Coinbase, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin, Crypto.com, MetaMask...), a common route for investment scams.

name: security-strict
title: Security (Strict)
description: Extra protection on top of security: spam/scam-heavy domain endings (e.g. .zip, .mov), dynamic DNS and abused free hosting used by malware, and apps that resell your internet connection. May block some legitimate sites. AdGuard Home / Pi-hole v6 adblock format recommended.

name: file-sharing
title: File Sharing
description: File-hosting and file-sharing sites (including Dropbox and many free hosts), common sources of malware and pirated files.

name: windows-telemetry
title: Windows & Office Telemetry
description: Microsoft data collection from Windows and Office. Windows Update and Office keep working.

name: shopping
title: Shopping
description: Online shopping sites, for limiting impulse buying.

name: fake-news
title: Fake News
description: Fake-news and clickbait-scam sites.

name: cults
title: Cults & Psychics
description: Sites of cults, sects and psychic/fortune-telling services.

name: url-shorteners
title: URL Shorteners
description: Link shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl and ~10,000 more) that hide where scam links go. Also breaks normal shortened links.
